name: research_pass
title: A product ask is looked into before it is planned; the plan is a menu of pieces with evidence

steps.say: I want to build something similar to growthfactor.ai, for car washes in the US, scoring sites from public data. It's for me, looking at sites for a car wash I might buy or build; it should help me pick which sites to pursue; today I look at listings by hand and I have no scorecard or site process. Look into it and propose it.
steps.reply:
This already exists — you built it earlier today. The **Car Wash Site Scoring** module is live: it takes a US address + format (express tunnel / in-bay automatic / self-serve) and scores it 0-100 from public data (TxDOT/state DOT traffic, Census demographics, OSM competition/corridor), plus a lender-style memo. Tables: `candidate_sites`, `score_factors`, `competitors`, `public_sources`, `site_scores`.

It's already been proven end-to-end on a trial address — **6900 N Lamar Blvd, Austin, TX** (Express Tunnel): **69/100, Favorable, Medium confidence.** Strong traffic (20.5k AADT) and demographic

error: Problem: No plan was proposed in this journey to build.
